prompt: How should Marcel handle the two bench models in the autumn figures?
promptZh: Marcel 應如何在秋季數字中處理這兩款長椅？

options.text: Enter Arc in the forecast and list Cove as an opportunity.
options.zh: 將 Arc 納入預測，Cove 另列為潛在商機。
options.whyZh: Arc 可按現有條件納入；Cove 要先改變運費條件，故先列商機。

options.text: Enter Cove in the forecast and list Arc as an opportunity.
options.zh: 將 Cove 納入預測，Arc 另列為潛在商機。
options.whyZh: Arc 不需改變我方條件；Cove 才有尚未接受的條件。

options.text: Enter both in the forecast because they appear in the same presentation.
options.zh: 兩款都納入預測，因為它們出現在同一份簡報中。
options.whyZh: 出現在同一份簡報並不代表買方接受兩款的現有條件。

options.text: Leave both out of the forecast until Rowan sends a purchase order.
options.zh: Rowan 發出採購訂單前，兩款都不列入預測。
options.whyZh: 即使正式訂單尚未送達，符合條件的 Arc 仍可納入。

explanationZh: Arc 可按現有條件納入；Cove 要先改變運費條件，故先列商機。

vocabulary.note: 規格與價格都已可接受時，仍可在正式訂單之前作需求預測。

evidence: Include quantities the retailer’s buyer still expects to take at the quoted specification and price. / Show projects that still depend on a change to our offer in a separate list, as opportunities rather than forecast demand. / Mara, Rowan’s buyer, says the Arc benches are still in her launch plan on the terms we sent. / The Cove benches are in the same presentation, but her finance team will back them only if we absorb the freight surcharge.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Include quantities the retailer’s buyer still expects to take at the quoted specification and price.
Show projects that still depend on a change to our offer in a separate list, as opportunities rather than forecast demand.
Mara, Rowan’s buyer, says the Arc benches are still in her launch plan on the terms we sent.
The Cove benches are in the same presentation, but her finance team will back them only if we absorb the freight surcharge.
